# Atropos
> Integrated technology for Tasmanian homes and businesses — Hobart, Tasmania, Australia

## About
Atropos designs, installs and supports integrated technology for homes and businesses across Tasmania: home theatre and multi-room audio visual, meeting rooms and unified communications, digital signage and LED screens, automation, networks and Wi-Fi, and managed IT. We work with homeowners, business owners, builders and architects. Parent company: Atropos Industries Pty Ltd, Hobart, TAS 7000.

## Services

### Residential
- Home Theatre: Dedicated cinemas, media rooms and living spaces — surround sound and Dolby Atmos, projection and displays, acoustic treatment, one-touch control and professional calibration.
- Audio Visual: Music through the house, televisions set into joinery, outdoor sound and screens, all run from one app.
- Network & Wi-Fi: Whole-home Wi-Fi and structured cabling that reaches every room, designed into the build or retrofitted.
- Smart Home Automation: Lighting, climate, blinds and entertainment working as one system, integrated with the security a household already has, with custom mobile, tablet and web control. New builds and retrofits.

### Commercial
- Unified Communications: Meeting rooms from huddle space to boardroom on Microsoft Teams, Zoom or the platform a business already uses, and integration with its existing phone system.
- Digital Signage & Audio Visual: Signage, LED screens and video walls that staff can update, zoned audio and paging, for workplaces and venues.
- Network & Wi-Fi: Business networks monitored and patched on a schedule, segmented so guests, payments and cameras are kept apart.
- Managed Services & IT Support: Managed IT (helpdesk, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, backups, device management), ad hoc IT support with no contract, and maintenance of the AV, network and control systems Atropos installs.
- Automation: Lighting, climate and blinds that follow occupancy and trading hours, across a floor, a tenancy or a building.

## Industries
- Hospitality & tourism: hotels, restaurants, bars, function venues and cellar doors.
- Offices & professional services: law firms, accountants, consultancies, not-for-profits and government offices.
- Health & aged care: GP, dental and allied health clinics, specialists and aged care homes.
- Retail: shops, showrooms and multi-site retailers.
- Education: independent schools and training providers.

## Brands we work with
Microsoft, Google, Ubiquiti, Netgear, Bluesound, Sonos, JBL, Sonance, Epson, Samsung, LG, Q-SYS, Kramer, Xilica, NEC and more.

## Service Area
All of Tasmania — Hobart, Launceston, Devonport, Burnie and everywhere between. Based in Hobart.
